ENTITY TYPE CAUTION: registered here on a narrow, explicitly bounded basis. Shanghai Electric Holdings Group's (entity_id shanghai_electric_holdings) FY2023 annual report shows Aishengna as a new 'significant associate' from 2023, with an initial investment of CNY 6,021,989,826.97 and a closing equity-method carrying value of CNY 4,645,190,501.10 at end-2023 -- these are the ONLY facts about Aishengna registered as observations in this packet, and they are shareholder-side equity-investment/equity-method accounting facts, not Aishengna's own revenue or product disclosure (no revenue line for Aishengna appears anywhere in SE Holdings' notes).

Press reporting (not a company filing, and not independently verified here) describes Aishengna as a state-owned entity established Aug/Sep 2023 with roughly RMB 70.01bn registered capital, shareholders including Shanghai Electric Holdings Group and a Shanghai International Trust unit, which has reportedly absorbed SMEE's and a separate firm Yuliangsheng's (上海宇量昇) immersion-DUV engineering teams and begun producing domestic immersion DUV scanners, with roughly five units planned for 2026 (named recipients: SMIC, Hua Hong, CXMT) and about twenty planned for 2027 (Reuters, 28 Jul 2026, citing one unnamed source and 'The Information'). If accurate, Aishengna would be a complete front-end exposure-tool builder and squarely in scope -- but NO company-reported claim (a filing, an issuer statement, or even an issuer product page) was found for Aishengna in this packet, only third-party investigative-journalism relying on anonymous sourcing. The Atlas's platform-maturity evidence rule requires claim_kind=company_reported; this reporting does not meet that bar, so NO platform record is registered for Aishengna's immersion scanner here -- see coverage/holds. This is the 'investigate only if cheap' third name from the brief: placed and bounded, not developed further. The only figures that exist for this entity anywhere in the atlas are SE Holdings' own investment cost and equity-method loss on its stake, carried on entity shanghai_electric_holdings at scope se_holdings_equity_stake_aishengna. This entity therefore has no observations of its own: it is a registered identity awaiting disclosure, not a measured firm.
